files.description: Playwright tests for Albums covering the overview and sidebar, create/delete and duplicate-name validation, selected and filter-wide photo adds, URL-backed selection across pagination, edit-mode cover and member removal, persistent drag reorder, and the no-paired-devices Share modal state — plus the family's responsive coverage: the contract width matrix for every albums route, the peer-panel contract for both registered panels (albums-nav and album-add-filters), narrow-width containment of tiles/header actions/the sticky selection bar, always-visible 44px reorder controls with a real emulated touch drag proving they are the only touch reorder path, selection and filter state surviving a resize through the breakpoint, dialog containment at 320px, and regressions for a long unbreakable album name and the crushed page-header title at tablet width.

testContext: The standard isolated runner seeds Seeded Album with four photos and a 33-item library (31 photos plus two videos). Album tests mutate shared state and run in one worker via test.describe.configure({ mode: 'default' }). /albums renders .album-tile entries and .albums-sidebar links; /albums/<id> renders #album-grid cards keyed by data-select-id; /albums/<id>/add renders #add-grid, #add-selection, and #add-to-album-button. Selection is URL-backed with repeated select_id values or select=all plus exclude_id, and the add button's data-match-count represents the full filtered scope rather than the visible page. Add success remains on /add with added=N. Edit mode is ?edit=1; cover and removal use #set-cover-button and #remove-from-album-button. Delete/removal use #global-confirm-dialog, not a native dialog. Reorder uses HTML5 drag events and POSTs repeated media_item_id fields to /reorder. The standard environment has no paired devices; #shareAlbumModal contains no device checkboxes and displays the pair-first empty state. Responsively, albums registers two panels: #albums-nav (the album list, toggle #albums-nav-toggle) and #album-add-filters (the bulk-add filter sidebar, toggle #album-add-filters-toggle). Below 1200px a registered panel is hidden until its peer button is pressed, so the album path must be read from an overview tile rather than the sidebar. HTML5 drag-and-drop emits nothing for a touch stream, so the ↑/↓ .album-reorder-button controls albums.js injects into each card in edit mode are the only touch reorder path; albums.css keeps them displayed whenever the grid is selecting and sizes them to 44px. Shared pagination links carry an aria-label, so their accessible name is "Next"/"First", not the visible "Next ›"/"« First".
explanation: Completed manually from specs/albums.yaml after inspecting the album templates, routes, client code, shared selection component, repository Playwright conventions, and live behavior in a freshly seeded isolated environment. The behaviour scenarios clean up album creation, names, membership, and order; the selected cover is retained because no test depends on the original. The responsive scenarios were added by hand in the P2 albums rollout (2026-08-30) against docs/development/responsive.md, importing the contract assertions from generated_tests/_support/responsive.ts rather than re-implementing them. Two of them are regressions with a named cause: a long unbreakable album name used to size .page-header, then .main-container, then the document, so every width scrolled sideways; and .page-header-main { flex: 1 } gave the title a zero basis, so the album's five header actions crushed it to ~58px at 768px. Validated with npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test:spec -- generated_tests/albums/albums.spec.ts --port 5202 (19 passed on 2026-08-30).
